All tests pass! The fix is complete. The issue was that JavaScript's floating-point arithmetic was producing `3995.0000000000005` instead of exactly `3995` when multiplying `39.95 * 100`. 

I wrapped the multiplication with `Math.round()` in both `parseEuros()` and `cellCents()` functions to handle this floating-point precision issue. Now 39.95 (and any other decimal price) will correctly convert to whole cents without the validation error.
